nodes.label: Archived Security Specification v2
nodes.rationale: Near-duplicate predecessor of docs/security-implementation.md, superseded on 2026-08-09. The two differ only in the role model, token lifetime table, client storage wording and §7: v2 describes four staff roles, a verification page and a rotating member identity payload; v3 describes administrator-only access and no QR credential.

nodes.label: Four-Role Access Matrix (Archived)
nodes.rationale: administrator (everything), manager (member list, detail and reports; explicitly cannot edit benefits, manage staff or export), outlet_staff (verification page only), support (single member by exact ID, no listing or browsing). The manager row's 'can reach' column lists screens rather than operations, which is why manager write access remained an inference rather than a stated requirement.

nodes.label: Outlet Staff Enumeration Restriction (Archived)
nodes.rationale: Real enforcement rather than a hidden menu item: no list endpoint exists for the role at all; lookup requires an exact membership number or scanned code with no partial matching or name search; the result is bound to a short-lived verification session; lookups are hard rate limited because sequential printed numbers make an unlimited lookup endpoint an enumeration tool; and failed lookups against non-existent numbers are logged and alerted.

nodes.label: Rotating Member Identity Payload v1 (Archived)
nodes.rationale: v1.<member_ref>.<issued_at>.<hmac>, where member_ref is an opaque random identifier and never the printed sequential number. The verification page rejects payloads older than a configured window, defeating forwarded screenshots. Identifies only — entitlement is resolved server-side and possession never applies a discount. The window is a tunable setting, not a hardcoded constant: start around 24 hours and adjust on observed verification failures.
